name: PEG-3 isostearate
description: PEG-3 Isostearate (CAS 56002-14-3 ), also referred to as Polyethylene Glycol Monoisostearate, is a low-ethoxylation ester of isostearic acid used as a nonionic emulsifier and wetting agent across personal care and industrial markets. Its short PEG chain delivers a hydrophilic-lipophilic balance suited to oil-in-water and water-in-oil emulsion systems where mild, skin-compatible ingredients are preferred for high-performance formulations. In personal care formulations, it functions as an emulsifier and moisturizing co-emulsifier in creams, lotions, and conditioning products, helping stabilize oil phases while contributing to skin feel. Textile processing operations use it as a fiber lubricant and wetting agent, improving dye penetration and reducing surface tension during finishing treatments to ensure consistent quality across batches. In coatings and adhesive systems, it acts as a dispersant and surface modifier, aiding pigment wetting and substrate adhesion. Leather treatment formulations also incorporate it to improve fat liquoring distribution. PEG-3 Isostearate is typically supplied as a liquid or semi-liquid at ambient temperature. Cosmetic-grade material meeting standard industry purity requirements is the most common commercial form available. It is available in bulk drums and intermediate bulk containers suited to industrial procurement volumes.
